pin.longFormSummary:
A 15-seat chocolate-cake café in SAKUMACHI Shopping Street, serving chocolate and matcha cake sets, homemade chai and a seasonal sweet-potato dessert.

Current SAKUMACHI branch opened July 23,2024 at 11:00 per June 28,2024 operator launch release, which explicitly lists the new Nagoya relocation after the Tokyo shop closed. Exact managed listing independently records 2024.7.23 andaddress 1-19-10 Osugi. Earlier 2020 brand creation/2021 Nagoya storefront and November 2026 promotion dates are not used for this physical branch.

details.hoursNote: 15 seats:10 table and 5 counter seats; non-smoking, no private room or on-site parking. Cards accepted; e-money andQRpayments not accepted. No service charge in original Japanese managed field. Private hire available, but template 20–50 capacity exceeds 15 seats: confirm actual arrangement directly. Ordinary eat-in sets list 45 minutes and homemade chai service; seasonal March–August andDecember–February products are not current stock claims. Operator announces November 26–29 fan café plan,¥3000 tax included per guest with one drink and chocolate-art plate. Reposting the specificXpost earns¥500 off; whether per guest or booking is not stated. Reserve by official InstagramDM. November 29 fallsSundayandconflicts with current closure: confirm special service before booking that date. Exact entry times, final orders, message approval and stock subject to branch confirmation. No band affiliation implied.
